prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opens mid-action: a whole fish laid onto a bed of lemon slices, herbs stuffed inside, olive oil poured over in a thick golden thread. The camera glides across a Mediterranean spread coming together — olives tumbling into a bowl, feta broken by hand into rough chunks, cherry tomatoes blistering in a hot pan. Money shot: the roasted fish emerging, skin golden and crisp, flesh flaking open under a fork in macro, backlit steam. Final beat: the table spread generous — fish, blistered tomatoes, greens with feta. Warm golden light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the oil pour, then the flake of the fish. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
